statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = true if and only if there exist an integer m >= 1 and a partition of the index set {0, ..., len(nums)-1} into m nonempty sets S_1, ..., S_m such that, for each j from 1 to m, writing the indices of S_j in increasing order as i_1 < ... < i_k, we have k >= 3 and nums[i_{t+1}] = nums[i_t] + 1 for every t with 1 <= t < k. If no such partition exists, r = false.
preconditions: nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; 1 <= len(nums) <= 10000; and -1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums).
